info.title: pi-agent-server host API
info.description:
Fixed host API contract v1. Dynamic plugin routes are not part of this document.
Request validation semantics: Request bodies use Fastify's AJV baseline: declared types are coerced (`coerceTypes: 'array'`,
so numbers, booleans, and single-element arrays are accepted where a string is declared) and
undeclared fields are silently stripped (`removeAdditional: true` combined with
`additionalProperties: false`) instead of returning 400. A 400 therefore reports a missing
required field or a value that cannot be coerced/constrained, never a wrong scalar type or an
unknown field.

Request bodies use Fastify's AJV baseline: declared types are coerced (`coerceTypes: 'array'`,
so numbers, booleans, and single-element arrays are accepted where a string is declared) and
undeclared fields are silently stripped (`removeAdditional: true` combined with
`additionalProperties: false`) instead of returning 400. A 400 therefore reports a missing
required field or a value that cannot be coerced/constrained, never a wrong scalar type or an
unknown field.

post.description:
The abort body is parsed by a hand-written strict validator, not by AJV: an absent body is
accepted, but a supplied body must contain exactly the `requestId` field with a string value.
Unknown fields and non-string values are rejected with 400 (no type coercion, no silent
stripping).

200.description: SSE stream. Each `data:` line is a SseEvent JSON value.

X-Server-Epoch.description: Present when the server epoch is configured.

204.description: Viewer may receive this when the owned session has no live runtime; no stream is created.

500.description: Session events could not be started.

IpAdmission.description: Mandatory direct-peer CIDR/IP admission. This is evaluated by the host, not supplied by a client.

BearerAuth.description: ip mode: required only when the admitted IP profile has tokenRequired=true. accounts mode: a personal token (pi_…) issued by `pnpm accounts -- issue-token`.

SessionCookie.name: pi_session_<port>
SessionCookie.description: accounts mode only: set by POST /v1/auth/login; the name ends with the effective port of PI_PUBLIC_URL. Cookie-authenticated POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE need a trusted Origin (PI_TRUSTED_ORIGINS), or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin when no Origin is sent; otherwise 403 csrf_rejected.

code.description: Fastify validation error code when applicable.

NestedToolCalls.description: Tool calls the tool made while it ran (for example MCP calls from a codemode script). At most 256 are recorded; complete is false when calls were dropped, arguments omitted, or calls had not finished.

argumentsBytes.description: Size of arguments omitted for exceeding the record limits.

publicOrigin.description: Origin of PI_PUBLIC_URL; the address every device should use.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Default thinking level per model from the Agent settings, keyed by provider/modelId. A new session without a chosen level uses its model's entry before defaultThinkingLevel.

canDelete.description: Current actor owns this non-default project; shared automatic projects are system-administered.

canCreateSession.description: Current route RBAC and project access allow creating an actor-owned private session; does not grant project mutation or access to other actors' private resources.

items.description: Client TimelineItem: message, thinking or tool, with the SDK message time as an ISO timestamp when recorded; sourceLabel records user provenance, hostInput (initial | steer) marks the host agent's turns and userInput (steer) a person's steer.

messages.description: Original SDK messages, without transcript truncation.

source.description: host: the parent agent; user: a person through POST /v1/sessions/{id}/subagents/{runId}/steer.

SessionSystemPrompt.description: Only current effective or creation snapshot provenance is reported. Historical structured records do not prove the forced prompt sent to a model. Empty strings are valid prompts.

visibility.description: Native shared sessions are available to admitted users subject to RBAC and cwd exclusions; absent means private.

firstPrompt.description: Read-only first persisted user prompt for display; never a rename payload.

truncated.description: The project listing hit its file cap; some paths cannot be suggested.

dayPart.description: The caller's local time of day.

recent.description: The caller's latest session in this project.

docked.description: Whether the companion sits on the composer inside a session.

status.description: missing: the project has a setting for a server no longer in the catalog; it is ignored.

oauthLabel.description: Present when each user connects with their own account (see /v1/mcp/connections); the server then enters only the connected owner's private sessions.

canEnable.description: Whether the caller may enable it: adminOnly servers need admin. Disabling is always allowed to editors.

updatedAt.description: null while the project uses the catalog defaults.

changed.description: The project's setting was made for an earlier server of the same name (another URL or command); it does not apply until saved again.

projectFile.description: defined: the server comes from the project's .pi/mcp.json. overridden: a shared server whose defaults (enabled, exposure, toolExposure) the project file changes for this project.

source.description: project: the project's own trust.json entry. parent: the entry of a folder above it. default: no entry, so defaultProjectTrust decides (only always trusts).

entryPath.description: The folder whose entry applies, when source is parent.

trusted.description: false: the project is not trusted (Pi's trust.json, then defaultProjectTrust), so the file is not loaded.

error.description: Why the file could not be read; the servers read before stay in use.

exposure.description: Server exposure, at most the catalog maxExposure; null uses the catalog default.

hiddenTools.description: Exact tool names, as the server offers them, to hide in this project.

headers.description: Values are masked as •••••• unless they only reference environment variables; send a masked value back to keep it.

enabled.description: false disables it everywhere, Pi TUI included.

oauth.description: Each user connects with their own account (HTTP only).

reason.description: Admins only: why the server cannot be used.

otherFields.description: Admins only: fields the form does not cover; saving keeps them.

error.description: The file cannot be read; sessions keep using what was read before.

autoCompaction.description: Compact the context automatically when it is nearly full (compaction.enabled).

autoRetry.description: Retry a failed model request automatically (retry.enabled).

modelThinkingLevels.description: Default thinking level per model, keyed by provider/modelId (modelThinkingLevels).

error.description: The file cannot be read, or some values in it are invalid; the service keeps using what was read before or the defaults.

project.description: Present when projectId is given and that project has a .pi/settings.json.

trusted.description: false: the project is not trusted, so the file is not loaded.

values.description: The values the file sets; they apply on top of the global ones to that project's sessions only.

error.description: The file cannot be read, or some values in it are invalid and do not apply.

values.description: Only the given values change; modelThinkingLevels, when given, replaces the whole map.

account.description: External account name, when the authorization server provides one.

expiresAt.description: Access token expiry in milliseconds since the epoch; tokens are refreshed automatically.

interactive.description: false: the key comes only from the environment or other ambient sources and cannot be entered here.

source.description: Where the credential comes from, for example an environment variable name.

steps.description: What the provider showed, in order.

prompt.description: The question waiting for an answer, while running.

args.description: compact: optional summary instructions. extension: the command's arguments.

name.description: extension: the command name without the leading /.

CommandPrompt.description: A dialog an extension command opened. While it is open the command's 3-minute limit is paused; unanswered, it closes after 10 minutes or the extension's own shorter timeout.

id.description: Preserved legacy host message id, if any.

sourceId.description: Pi JSONL message-entry id. When present, exactly matches timeline.messageId; image-only messages have one too.

CompactionState.description: Ephemeral runtime metadata at lastEventId; absent without an observed live compaction and cleared once the owning task or command ends (completed/error/aborted), so a finished compaction is never replayed. Restore running as unknown until live confirmation. No summary or SDK error.

stopReason.description: Explicitly interrupted assistant text; omitted when unavailable, never inferred from partial text.

SteeringInput.description: Legacy text-only or complete correlated identity, optionally with images. File attachments are not supported. Admission is not consumption.

SteeringConsumed.description: Exact queued SDK user-message object was consumed once. Optional message projects its persisted user entry, before subsequent assistant deltas; sourceId deduplicates live/replay/export history. Missing message never implies a visible user bubble. Nonterminal; never acknowledge by matching text.

oneOf.description: The session-steps projection moved, from any source (live events, persisted reconciliation, branch change, idle-time entries). Coalesced to at most one per 250 ms with the final position always sent. Carries no step content: read GET /v1/sessions/{id}/steps; a new projectionId replaces the snapshot. Session-level, never request-owned.

Subagent records or live output moved: a transcript entry (start, message, steer, end), a live partial, or a legacy collected-log tool result. Coalesced to at most one per 250 ms with the final change always sent; also sent while the parent is idle and children run in the background. Carries no run data: read GET /v1/sessions/{id}/subagents. Session-level, never request-owned.

The session title changed: renamed through PATCH /v1/sessions/{id}, by a plugin, or set automatically from the first prompt by the default model. Sent only while the session has a live runtime. Session-level, never request-owned.
